# `mssql` type mapping

Generated from [`drivers/mssql/internal/datatype_conversion.go`](https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake/blob/v1.1.2/drivers/mssql/internal/datatype_conversion.go) at `v1.1.2`. Source column type (lower-cased by the driver) to the OLake type in `available_streams.json`. A type not listed here is read as `String`. How each OLake type lands in Iceberg or Parquet: `olake-destination-abstract`.

## `mssqlTypeToDataTypes`

| OLake type | Source types |

| `Timestamp` | `date`, `smalldatetime`, `datetime` |
| `TimestampMicro` | `datetime2`, `datetimeoffset` |
